content.value: It is sometimes suggested that architects live in the past; that in the $2 1 ^ { \mathrm { s t } }$ century they should be building with fiberglass, aluminum alloys and stainless steel. Consider the possibility of replacing wooden or concrete column show in figure $6 ( \mathsf { c } )$ of a building with AA 6061 aluminum alloys or AISI 304 stainless steel.
